findings.title: Eval guidance understates paid decision-model requests
findings.why_it_matters: An operator relying on this guidance could underestimate paid usage: enabling measurement also runs calibration over 20 planted findings in three variants, described as approximately 180 decision-provider requests in the workflow dispatch input.
findings.first_evidence: .github/workflows/AGENTS.md:64 -- It is report-only by construction: it can never change the job's result, so turning it on cannot make the required check flaky — it only adds one small decision request per finding.
